a.lede: After sounding an alarm about the issue, Apple is taking steps to limit Mac disk access to AI agents.
a.title: Apple adds new disk controls to prevent AI agents from running amok

b.lede: Following an October announcement, Apple has detailed new permission controls, warnings, and transparency features coming to macOS 27.3 to address risks posed by AI agents and other apps.
b.title: Apple reveals new Mac security controls as AI agents raise privacy risks
